content.text: Totally common at this age. At 28 months, testing the limits is normal. The one thing to try tonight is a calm, boring return. Keep the bedtime routine short and predictable, and tell them the rule up front: "After songs, you stay in bed." If they get up, walk them back with almost no talking or eye contact, every time, and keep it just as dull at 2am as at 8pm. The consistency is what makes it work, so it can take a week or so of this before it sticks.
